intent: Carry the three non-visual, currently open Dependabot version proposals from PRs #224, #226 and #229 onto current dev through one regenerated lockfile, verify them against the full product gate, and preserve their exact former heads before retiring each addressed source PR.

reasons.evidence: Closing addressed PRs and deleting source branches is externally consequential; the operator explicitly authorised cleanup after preserving all important work.
The completed dependency change is pushed to dev and triggers hosted CI.

programme: T-0174 dev@8785a04e passed all four hosted push/PR workflows and every required job before this task opened. Dependabot automatically closed PRs #235 and #236 unmerged and removed their remote branches; their exact former heads are retained at refs/archive/t0174/. PRs #224, #226 and #229 remain open against dev, each at the head recorded in the preservation review and each changing only package.json and package-lock.json. Their proposals are React Query 5.102.8, tsx 4.23.13 and dagre 3.1.1. The other remaining proposals are separately scoped for visual libraries, test tooling and the React paired update.
invariants: Only the three named direct package ranges change in this batch; the lockfile is regenerated on current dev, not copied from stale PR heads. Exact direct and resolved versions are evidenced.
No existing test identity or coverage floor changes. An independent oracle is red before the manifest edit, then green without amendment by the implementer.
A full gate on an unchanged isolated tree, dependency audit and committed-tree mutation sweep precede closure. Visual graph behaviour is walked if the dagre update changes a rendered layout.

Each PR remains open until its proposal is shown to be addressed and hosted dev validation passes. Its exact head is retained in a local non-branch archive ref before any closure. Remote branch deletion uses a full-SHA lease only if closure leaves that exact head present.
At most two disjoint writing lanes are active. Only dev is pushed; PR #157, main, unaddressed PRs and dirty worktrees remain intact.
rollback: Revert the three direct ranges and regenerate package-lock.json on dev, retaining oracle and task evidence. Archived PR heads permit recovery if a proposal must be revisited.
verify_line: The frozen oracle, focused tests, npm audit, full unchanged-tree gate, lockfile integrity, committed-tree mutation sweep, all hosted push/PR jobs, and exact-head PR archive/ref checks must each pass before closure.
